---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused, measurable improvement
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

Describe the concrete limitation.

## Proposed behavior

Explain how it preserves compact context and bounded tool use.

## Evidence

Include synthetic fixtures or measurements, with hardware and methodology when performance is involved.

## Capability status

State whether the affected behavior is implemented, fixture-only, experimental, planned/deferred or out of scope.

## Security/privacy check

Confirm the report contains only synthetic data and no credentials, private paths, customer data, raw logs, model files or proprietary source.
